title: Promotional Campaign Duration and Word of Mouth in Solar Panel Adoption
authors: Bryan K. Bollinger; Kenneth T Gillingham; Stefan Lamp; Tsvetan G. Tsvetanov
eligible_reason: No qualifying main-text specification. Main tables (3, 5, 6) compare Solarize Express vs Classic towns after the campaigns end (sample solarize_post == 1; 16 towns, 11 Classic and 5 Express): reghdfe inst_share installer_tot inst_solarize_share express##post [controls], absorb(date_month). There are no town fixed effects (only a pooled express dummy plus month FE), 'post' marks the second post-campaign year rather than an adoption date, and every column includes time-varying controls (installer_tot, inst_solarize_share, event_workshop, cost, sales leads, WOM). Table 6 is OLS/IV on a WOM measure. The only town-FE + week-FE TWFE regressions (Tables B2 and OB2, appendixA&B.do line 54 and appendixOB.do line 94) are appendix-only and enter two campaign-type indicators (classic, express) jointly; campaigns also switch off at their end.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe, areg + boottest wild cluster bootstrap, ivreg2). Main text: Table 3 t-tests on leads/installs; Table 5 post-campaign growth regressions; Table 6 OLS, first stage, IV for word of mouth (instrument: ambassador home solar suitability x campaign start); Figure 5 SEM; Figure 6 cumulative installs. Appendix: Table B2 price on classic + express with week FE and town FE; Table OB2 installations on classic + express (and duration-phase splits) with week FE and town FE.

specs.exclusion_reason: no unit (town) FE: pooled express dummy with date_month FE in the post-campaign sample; 'post' is the second post-campaign year, not a staggered adoption; time-varying controls (installer_tot, inst_solarize_share; cols 2-4 add event_workshop, cost, sales_leads_norm, WOM)
OLS/IV of installs on a WOM measure with month FE and time-varying controls; IV
appendix only; two campaign-type treatment indicators (classic, express) entered jointly (additional treatment); campaigns switch off at campaign end

data_files_note: README: underlying customer data are sensitive; anonymized town-level data shipped that replicate the main tables (post_data.dta 868 town-months; during_data.dta 8,716 town-weeks).
data_provenance_note: Town-level aggregates of the original data with real town names; customer information removed. No noise or synthetic values mentioned.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF; table numbers from README and do-file comments). Not a near-miss: the main design is a post-campaign Express-vs-Classic comparison without town FE, not a staggered TWFE design; the staggered town-week TWFE regressions are appendix-only with two simultaneous treatments.
